messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: Magic Miner 40T is $799, Batch 6, ships Nov 21 2026; at under 12¢ its power runs roughly $20–25 a month.

Hey, I'm Sarah! At about ten cents the Magic Miner 40T costs around $47 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T is tunable: 30 TH at 450W (~$32/mo at 10¢), 40 TH at 650W ($47), 50 TH at 850W (~$61); ~50 dB in Eco, $16/TH.
Nice, the 40T fits right in at $799, and it's about forty-seven dollars a month in power at ten cents. What are you running now?
Looked up for Sarah: Next to big pool ASICs the 40T is the solo lottery box: quiet 50 dB, your own node, full block reward. Cheapest per TH we sell; PunkHash 70T $1,100 is the bigger step.
Then you'll like that it's tunable: thirty terahash at about thirty-two dollars a month, up to fifty at around sixty-one. Would you run it quiet or flat out?
Looked up for Sarah: Eco is 30 TH at 450W, ~$32 a month, ~50 dB — desk-quiet. Batch 6, 50 units, $799, ships November 21, 2026.
In eco mode it hums at about fifty decibels and costs around thirty-two dollars a month. It's also your solo shot at a full block. Want one from Batch 6?
Looked up for Sarah: PunkHash 70T: $1,100, 1.45 kW (~$104/mo at 10¢), own circuit, not a desk unit, Q4 2026 — and currently sold out, none released. The 40T is buyable today.

The P. is seventy terahash for eleven hundred, but it costs about a hundred and four dollars a month in power and has no units released yet. The 40T ships November twenty-first. Want it? (The call ended. 4 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
